BERTHA (*Behavioural Replication of Human Drivers for CCAM*) developed a probabilistic Driver Behavioural Model (DBM) that reproduces key aspects of human driving and can be integrated into simulation-based validation of automated vehicles. Model components are available through the BERTHA Data HUB and were integrated into the CARLA simulation environment.

::: {.mz-facts}
Funding
: Horizon Europe (CCAM Partnership), grant agreement [101076360](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101076360)

Website
: [berthaproject.eu](https://berthaproject.eu/)

Duration
: November 2023 – 2026

My role
: Task leader of T1.2 (stratification of the driver population according to driving styles, reported in D1.2) and T5.4 (acceptance testing)
:::
